opening.argument: The presentation identifies a real-estate consultancy offering named Karachi property options, stated price ranges, and investment guidance for overseas viewers. It says, “I guide you guys about Investment in Scheme 45,” describes an “Investment Range: 11 to 20 Lacs,” and presents the organization as providing “selling purchasing consultancy in all authentic societies of Scheme 45.” The invitation to meet and invest and the reference to fast growth are plainly promotional, but they do not by themselves establish deception. The material does not show fabricated ownership, misuse of payments, or a completed loss. Its discussion of selected-sector growth and a long-term option therefore remains investment promotion within an ordinary property-services presentation, without evidence sufficient to establish fraudulent conduct.
